# Anthony Tulk

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>
- **Role:** pupil  <sub>[v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony has a small, dark, and gloomy face with black eyes. His appearance suggests he could be a fairly pleasant boy if his sullen exterior were penetrated.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010)_

## Personality

Anthony displays a sullen, cheeky, and defiant temperament. He often carries himself with an impertinent swagger and a disdainful look of endurance, treating authority with contempt. Though he displays an exterior of hostile indifference, he is capable of being moved to tears under physical punishment and acts out emotionally when upset.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_

## History

Anthony Tulk, an orphaned nephew of Timothy Cotton, was taken in by Mrs. Laurence Tulk and enrolled at the local school taught by Nell Harcourt. From his arrival, he showed hostility toward Nell, glaring at her and resisting her efforts to win his favor. During one school day, he emptied his slate bottle water onto Aurelia Clay's neck, and when kept in during recess by Nell for a lecture on gentlemanly behavior, he listened sullenly and let out a contemptuous whistle as he left. He regularly complied with orders with a disdainful swagger and whispered or whispered in class when others dared not. When Nell delivered a sharp punishment with a pointer during a particularly stressful school day, his defiance finally gave way and he shrank back in tears. Upon learning later that Nell had resigned as teacher, Anthony vented his emotional distress on his way home by engaging in two deliberate, unprovoked fights with fellow boys.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P45](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0045), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c5 P10](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0010), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c12 P1](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0001), [v2 c12 P21](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0021), [v2 c12 P28](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0028), [v2 c12 P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 c26 P34](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0034)_
